about: Client photo mode: the colour grading chosen in the photo-mode UI (gui::DCPhotoMode::OnColorGradingChanged), applied by ecl::photo_mode::ColorGradingSystem while photo mode is active. Never seen alive.

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x1AF5D10 (AllocRaw 0x10) writes 0xFFFFFFFF and registers the FixedString destructor bg3.exe+0x698FE0. Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x593DC0 (ColorGradingSystem::UpdateColorGrading) compares +0 as an int and assigns it with ls::FixedString::operator=; macOS DCPhotoMode::OnColorGradingChanged takes it from the selected UI entry (+0x60 of the object at DCPhotoMode+0x988).

macOS gui::DCPhotoMode::OnColorGradingChanged (bg3_macos_x64+0x28AF530) copies DCPhotoMode+0xB10 into the ColorGrading request at +0x14 (request +0x10 FixedString Id, then +0x14/+0x18/+0x1C in component order); gui::DCPhotoMode::DCPhotoMode registers Noesis symbol 'Contrast' right after that value (value at +0xB10, AddString("Contrast") stored at +0xB10+4, the pattern 'DOFStrength'/'DOFDistance' follows for the DoF fields). Name is the photo-mode UI property, not a member name.

macOS gui::DCPhotoMode::OnColorGradingChanged (bg3_macos_x64+0x28AF530) copies DCPhotoMode+0xB28 into the ColorGrading request at +0x18 (request +0x10 FixedString Id, then +0x14/+0x18/+0x1C in component order); gui::DCPhotoMode::DCPhotoMode registers Noesis symbol 'Saturation' right after that value (value at +0xB28, AddString("Saturation") stored at +0xB28+4, the pattern 'DOFStrength'/'DOFDistance' follows for the DoF fields). Name is the photo-mode UI property, not a member name.
